text:
marco: quick UX flag from the design pass — three small inconsistencies between console help panels and docs that confuse users: copy, anchor behavior, and keyboard visibility in dark theme. posting findings so we can assign fixes.

anya: can you list repros?

marco: 1) Copy: console CTAs say "Pin model" while docs use "Lock version" (users hesitating during rollouts). 2) External docs links like .../guides#pin open console but don't land on the same heading. 3) Dark theme: tab focus ring in panel is very faint.

rita: agree on canonicalizing wording. my vote: "Pin model version" (explicit). saves ambiguous verbs.

sam: +1 to explicit. also suggest emitting an analytics event `help_pin_cta` so we can measure support volume by wording.

docs-bot: noted: docs team will accept a change to canonical term; will add redirects for legacy anchors.

anya: for anchors: likely alias mismatch. propose an alias resolver map e.g. {pinning, pin-model, lock-version}. attempt requested id then fallbacks, then scroll + focus.

aria-bot: accessibility note: when auto-scrolling to an anchor, run `element.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})` before moving focus. ensure focus ring is updated post-scroll so screen readers don't get dislocated context.

rita: for dark focus ring: change `:focus-visible` to use `--accent-contrast` and bump to 2px. low-risk CSS patch.

marco: plan: rita -> css patch; anya -> alias resolver + small e2e keyboard test; sam -> analytics; docs-bot -> redirects. target: ship before next deploy.

sam: i'll add the analytics event and a tiny dashboard to monitor alias usage so we can decide which legacy anchors to remove.

marco: add a short line to release notes about accessibility + copy harmonization (enterprise customers appreciate the clarity). thanks all :thumbsup:
